title: Snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='snow' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cfe6ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='snow2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bcd8f5'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='33' ry='6' fill='#8fb6dd'/>

  <!-- bottom ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='19' fill='url(#snow)' stroke='#a8cbed' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- middle ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='15' fill='url(#snow2)' stroke='#a8cbed' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='12' fill='url(#snow)' stroke='#a8cbed' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='36' y='15' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a4a7a'/>
  <!-- hat top -->
  <rect x='40' y='1' width='20' height='15' rx='3' fill='#54689e'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='40' y='11' width='20' height='4' fill='#e8563f'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='25' r='2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='25' r='2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>

  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,29 62,31 50,33' fill='#ff8c2b' stroke='#e06f16' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- smile: coal dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#2b2b3a'/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M36 40 Q50 48 64 40 L64 45 Q50 53 36 45 Z' fill='#e8563f' stroke='#c33f2c' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M58 44 L62 58 L56 58 L53 45 Z' fill='#f06a52' stroke='#c33f2c' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- middle buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.6' fill='#3a3a4a'/>

  <!-- bottom buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='77' r='1.8' fill='#3a3a4a'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M35 50 L20 43' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M20 43 L13 47' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M20 43 L17 36' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M65 50 L80 43' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M80 43 L87 47' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M80 43 L83 36' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
